from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record extracted from a single document indicating its legal cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the legal document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    legal_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action (案由) the document belongs to, matching the provided task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted case records from a document."""
    case_records: list[CaseRecord] = Field(description="List of case classifications found in this document")
